# Insights/Codex This guide will explain Insight Traits and the Codex which are key to progressing your characters abilities.
Both the Codex and your Insight Traits can be viewed through the 'Insights' tab of the [bold]Job Network Menu[/bold]
## The Codex The Codex is a collection or lore entries related to the mysteries, Nations and science that form the important background lore of the server.
### Unlocking Codex Entries There are many different ways that codex entries can be unlocked. [bold]Hovering over a locked codex entry will give you a hint[/bold] on what you need to do to unlock it. Many codex entries are [bold]unlocked by using a codex fragment[/bold] which is a device obtained through [bold]Rumored Imports[/bold].
## Insight Traits As your character collects knowledge about the Threshold they gain key insights that grant passive bonuses or active abilities. Progressing down an Insight Category will reveal stronger traits.
## Unlocking Insight Traits Every five codex entries that you unlock will grant you an Insight Trait selection. Insight Traits are chosen through the 'Insights' section of the [bold]Job Network Menu[/bold].
[bold]Insight Trait Selection is permanent and cannot be rechosen[/bold]
## Sector Awakening To unlock the third tier of Insight Trait the sector must undergo an awakening. This is triggered by spending Resonance through the Resonance Market
